sources.title: mlx-community/ltx-2.5-mlx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Python-MLX (ltx-2-mlx, branch ltx-2.5) and Swift-MLX (ltx-2-mlx-swift) both generate end to end, including the DFR pipeline with temporal rounds. Parity-gated per component against the PyTorch reference: text encoder 49 states (mean cosine 0.999985), DiT forward, sampler, keyframe slots, and the DFR canvas geometry bit-exactly.
